aidReceipts.summary: Need-eligible Texas first-bachelor’s students: tuition covered to family AGI $100,000; partial tuition support to $125,000. Federal/state grants count toward coverage; not automatically all living expenses. FAFSA/TASFA and renewal conditions apply.

Eligible service-area high-school/homeschool and first-time Texas GED classes 2024–2028 receive three years of ACC tuition support; eligible ACC bachelor’s pursuit can add two years. Not universal free living, books or supplies.

From July 1, 2026, new Grad PLUS generally unavailable; professional limits generally $50,000 annual and $200,000 aggregate, with $257,500 overall lifetime student borrowing limit and statutory exceptions. Legacy exception requires qualifying enrollment as of June 30 and a Direct Loan for that program before July 1, limited to expected time to credential. Court stay affects degree classification. Do not universally assign every graduate health program the lower graduate cap.
Graduate/professional degree study is not eligible for undergraduate Pell. Limited postbaccalaureate teacher/workforce exceptions do not make MD/DDS study Pell-eligible.

requirementsReceipts.summary: Typical bachelor’s plus four-year MD/DO then specialty-dependent residency (BLS 3–9 years). TMB U.S./Canadian graduate legal minimum postgraduate training is one continuous qualifying year; this does not equal completion of specialty residency. Show paid resident training separately from attending earnings.

Prerequisite college education plus DDS/DMD. UTHealth Houston minimum undergraduate coursework is 90 semester hours, not an unconditional bachelor’s admission requirement. Texas exam route requires CODA school graduation, national boards/INBDE, accepted clinical exam and state application/jurisprudence/training requirements. General dentists do not have a universal specialty-residency requirement.
